camera: Flat front-facing full-screen UI over a patterned backdrop; no 3D.

hudLayout.topThird: Full-screen dark navy backdrop with a repeating pattern of thin outlined up-arrow chevrons. Top-centre (2-6%): a charcoal counter slab with a green glossy star and white bold '2,000'. Around 20-27%: large white bold title 'Level 2' and below it white bold caps 'UPGRADE TO LEVEL 3'. Khaki panel starts at 27.5%.
hudLayout.middleThird: Khaki parchment panel (14-86% width, 27.5-72% height): cream bold title 'Farm Hand'; a centred henchman card in a thick grey bevelled frame with plum base, showing a cheerful boy hoisting a huge turnip on a sunny farmyard with hay bales; caption 'Loyal and hard working' in cream.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Below the panel (75-78%): green star icon with large yellow bold cost '100'. 79-84%: two side-by-side soft-slab buttons, lime-olive 'Upgrade' left and crimson 'Cancel' right. Rest is patterned navy backdrop.

uiStyle: Chunky 9-slice slabs: charcoal counter, flat khaki panel with darker lip, grey bevelled card frame, lime and crimson buttons with darker front lips and hard offset shadows; white bold sans headings.
colorPalette: Cold dark navy patterned backdrop vs warm khaki panel; lime and crimson CTAs and yellow cost number are the saturated accents.
composition: Vertical centred stack: counter, title, card panel, cost, two buttons; perfectly symmetric.
